sb_prompt: FIND OUT ABOUT THE OTHER CALLER'S HOME.  IS IT A TYPICAL HOME FOR THE AREA?  HOW DOES IT COMPARE TO YOUR HOME?
turns: So, what kind of home do you have?
I live in a small apartment. It's not too bad, but it's not exactly what I want either.
Yeah, I know what you mean. I live in a house, but it's not really what I want either.
Well, it's just that I'm not really a homebody. I'm always on the road, so I don't really get to enjoy it that much.
I see. I can imagine that would make it hard to feel settled. What do you do for work?
I'm a truck driver. It's not the most glamorous job, but it pays the bills.
Oh, that sounds interesting. I work as a restaurant server, so I'm always on my feet too. What's your favorite thing about being on the road?
I love the freedom of it. I get to see so many different places and meet all kinds of people. It's not always easy, but it's worth it to me.
That sounds nice. I imagine it would be hard to be away from home for long periods of time, though.
Yeah, it can be. But I've gotten used to it over the years. And it's not all bad, you know? I get to come home and have some downtime, which is nice.
Yeah, I can imagine that would be a nice change of pace. What's your favorite thing to do when you're not working or on the road?
I love spending time with my dog. She's my best friend and always makes me laugh. What about you?
I love spending time with my friends and family. We always have fun together, whether it's going out to eat or just hanging out at home.
That sounds great. I don't have any family nearby, so I don't get to see them very often. But I'm lucky to have some good friends who I can always count on.
That's good to hear. It's important to have people you can rely on. Well, it was nice talking to you. Thanks for sharing your experiences.
You too! It was great chatting with you. Take care!
